composition.serve_who: This sheet serves the vessel's 24V DC distribution network, detailing the main AFT, FWD, and EMERGENCY DC breaker panels. The evidence is the drawing title '+24 V DC DISTRIBUTION' and the regional labels specifying itemized loads for the 'AFT PANEL DC BREAKERS', 'FWD PANEL DC BREAKERS', and 'EMERGENCY POWER SUPPLY'.

facts: Fed from main '24V SERVICE SUPPLY' line.
Provides heavy direct fused feeds (F7, F8, F?) to the Main Bilge Pump, Fire Pump, and Tender Winch via respective switches (SW8, SW9, SW?).
The supply trunk splits to feed the FWD PANEL DC BREAKERS and the AFT PANEL DC BREAKERS.
The feed to the AFT PANEL DC BREAKERS passes through current transformer CT8, labeled 'to ONYX', providing monitoring data back to the ONYX system.
Includes a direct tap labeled 'to ONYX' from the incoming emergency battery line.
Distributes emergency power via the 'EMERGENCY POWER SUPPLY' breaker bank (QE1-QE8) and the 'EMERGENCY PANEL' (CB5-CB8).
